name: navigator-staged-flow-decision
body:
Decision record for the navigator-staged-flow change-set.

SOURCE. The distributed `codebase-navigator` prompt must bake in a STRICT, canonical, always-followed end-to-end staged process and state that it is always strictly followed: no stage may be skipped, and implementation must not begin until the spec and the plan are reviewed green. The canonical sequence is spec (`spec-writer`) → spec review (`spec-review`) → plan skeleton (`plan-writer`) → plan-skeleton review (`plan-review`) → plan phases/tasks (`plan-writer`) → plan-phases review (`plan-review`) → holistic plan review (`plan-review`) → implement (owning `implementer`/`*-implementer`) → implementation phase review (`implementation-phase-reviewer`).

VERIFIED AGAINST THE BRANCH GRAPH. The edit target `opencode-suite/agents/codebase-navigator.md` resolves as a File node (`code_type = docs`, 632 lines), so the component's `implemented-by` target resolves and NO planned Implementation node is needed for it. The existing narrow component `solution.component.codebase-navigator-prompt` is already implemented-by exactly that file; the broad sibling `solution.component.navigator-prompt-guidance` is implemented-by BOTH the navigator and agent-builder prompts. Existing navigator requirements not duplicated or overloaded: `navigator-task-cadence`, `navigator-session-isolation`, `navigator-scan-permission`, `navigator-no-unguarded-main-git`, `graph-first-navigation`.

DISTINCTNESS [autonomous]. This requirement is the ORDERED, GATED lifecycle of a change-set (the macro stage sequence with the no-skip / gated-implementation invariant), which none of the existing navigator requirements state: `navigator-task-cadence` is the per-task commit → scan → mark-done ordering under the staleness guard; `navigator-session-isolation` is the fresh-session / sole-resume policy; the others are scan authorization, git grants and graph-first querying.

DOMAIN DECISION [autonomous]. Added a NEW sibling entity `domain.entity.staged-delivery-process` rather than overloading `domain.entity.task-execution-cadence` or `domain.entity.subagent-session-isolation`: the new concern is the macro lifecycle, not the per-task mutation ordering or the session-lifecycle policy. The new entity is bare (no `contains` parent), mirroring its sibling `domain.entity.task-execution-cadence`.

SOLUTION DECISION [autonomous]. Created a NEW narrow component `solution.component.navigator-staged-flow-prompt` whose ONLY `implemented-by` target is the one edited file, per the change-set instruction to prefer a narrow new component. This keeps derived solution coverage 1:1 to the edited file and pulls in no untouched code. Two components sharing one code target is an established pattern in this tree (the two navigator coherence-test components both own `rust.main_e2e.e2e.coordinator_agent_carries_review_action_and_dispatch_prose`). Reusing the existing `solution.component.codebase-navigator-prompt` was the alternative — it too is implemented-by exactly this file — but the instruction preferred a new narrow owner, so the existing component's realised-by set is left unchanged.

CONSTRAINT DECISION [autonomous]. Authored a NEW law `requirements.constraint.navigator-staged-flow-stated` (attaches-to the new requirement), following the prose-law pattern of `requirements.constraint.navigator-cadence-stated` and `requirements.constraint.subagent-sessions-isolated`. It names the observable acceptance: the prompt states the ordered stages with their owning subagents and the no-skip / gated-implementation invariant.

SPINE. `requirements.user.navigator-agent` ⊃ `requirements.requirement.navigator-staged-flow` —drives→ `domain.entity.staged-delivery-process` —realised-by→ `solution.component.navigator-staged-flow-prompt` —implemented-by→ `opencode-suite/agents/codebase-navigator.md`; the new component `contains` under `solution.container.opencode-suite`.

SCOPE. This change-set edits ONLY `opencode-suite/agents/codebase-navigator.md` — no `AGENTS.md`, no test, no binary. No existing requirement is declared satisfied by this component. The repo's own `.opencode/agents/**` are consumer artifacts and are never edited.
